# STYLE-001: Code Style Convention

## Naming
- Files: kebab-case (e.g., `auth-service.ts`)
- Classes: PascalCase
- Functions and variables: camelCase
- Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE

## Formatting
- 2-space indentation
- Semicolons required
- Single quotes for strings
- Trailing commas in multi-line constructs
